page.layout: One leaf, blank on this side. Faint, mirrored and inverted text and an engraving are show-through from the other side. The right edge shows part of the neighbouring page.
page.notes: Blank leaf. The faint blue-grey lines are show-through from the reverse, mirrored and upside down, and are not transcribed. They appear to be a title page: "PETRI POIRET" above "COGITATIONUM RATIONALIUM DE DEO, ANIMA, ET MALO LIBRI QUATUOR", with an engraving and an imprint at the foot ("AMSTELODAMI, Apud DANIELEM ELZEVIRIUM", date not legible with confidence). The title itself should be transcribed from the recto of this leaf. The digitiser's credit line at the bottom, the shelf mark "232 K 33", and the strip of the neighbouring page at the right edge are excluded.
